subject: Adoption velocity and commit opportunity
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara@adeptly.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Adoption velocity and commit opportunity

Hey Grace,

Quick note from our side — adoption of the assistant inside Adeptly has gone from pilot to ~7k active users, and token spend has jumped 3.6x in the last 6 weeks. We’re hitting rate limits in a few critical paths (customer search + summarization).

We have our renewal coming up in May and procurement asked whether a committed model would get us a better per-token rate AND a predictable runway for capacity. From a product POV we expect another spike as we roll the assistant to sales in March.

Can you share a short health readout (usage by route, latency trends, QoR) and a quick sketch of what a step-up commit would look like (6 mo or 12 mo)? Happy to set a call next week. I’m looping Jordan (ops) and procurement.

Thanks —
Sara
Sara Liu
Head of Product
Adeptly

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara@adeptly.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Adoption velocity and commit opportunity

Hi Sara — thanks for the context, congrats on the traction. Short summary below, attaching an export and a brief perf report you can share with procurement.

Key signals (Q1):
- Total tokens (30 days): 132M tokens, 78% from summarization routes, 15% from search, 7% from chat flows.
- 95th pct latency (in-region): 220ms for chat, 340ms for long-summary paths (due to longer sequences).
- Error rate: steady ~0.4% (spikes during peak windows when auto-batching hit thresholds).

Initial recomendation: a stepped commit that matches your expected adoption curve. Example: 6-month commit with 20% step-up at month 3 to cover sales roll-out risk. With that structure we can offer:
- 18% blended unit discount vs on-demand for first 3 months, then 22% after the step-up.
- Guaranteed headroom for peak SLA windows (we provision burst capacity tied to the commit).

Attached: adeptly_usage_q1.csv (route-level export), redwood_q1_performance_report.pdf (latency and error breakdown).

Next steps: can we do a 30-min sync Mon/Tue next week? If procurement wants an initial MA P, I can draft a mutual action plan and loop in CS/ops for runbook items.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead, Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference

[attachments: adeptly_usage_q1.csv (CSV), redwood_q1_performance_report.pdf (PDF)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-22T09:07:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Adoption velocity and commit opportunity — pricing input request

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Adeptly thread. They are a clear step-up candidate and will likely need a stepped 6mo or 12mo commit.

Notes for pricing:
- Current run-rate: ~132M tokens/month, expected to grow to ~250M after sales roll-out in 8–12 weeks.
- Target: keep their 95th pct latency under 300ms for summarization (we may need to pin model variant or apply heavier quantization for batch jobs).

Can you draft two proposals:
1) 6mo step-up commit (month 1–3 baseline, month 4–6 +20%) with blended discount and burst credits.
2) 12mo linear commit with gradual step-ups and a lower unit price.

Marissa — can you assemble a 2-slide ops + ROI deck highlighting: token mix, expected cost delta, and SLA commitments? Need this by EOD Thurs so I can send to Adeptly before the call.

Thanks —
Grace

From: Jordan Fields <jordan.fields@adeptly.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara@adeptly.ai>, procurement@adeptly.ai
Date: 2027-02-24T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Adoption velocity and commit opportunity

Grace — this looks great, appreciate the quick turnaround. A few asks from my side before we lock the call:
- Can you include a short MAP with milestones and expected deliverables? Procurement wants dates for contract execution, migration verification, and a rollback plan.
- We also need a short summary of evidence for SOC 2 + data retention options (we can discuss redaction options for summaries).
- KPI list: latency (95th), token spend ceiling per month, success rate for summary generation.

We can do Tue 2/28 10am PT for a 30-min call. Procurement would like to see a draft MAP and contract economics beforehand.

Jordan
Head of Ops
Adeptly

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Fields <jordan.fields@adeptly.ai>, Sara Liu <sara@adeptly.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@adeptly.ai
Date: 2027-02-27T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Adoption velocity and commit opportunity — MAP + meeting details

Jordan / Sara — thanks, confirmed Tue 02/28 10:00am PT. I’m attaching a one-page mutual action plan and a draft economics table for the two proposals Ben is preparing. Also attaching the SOC 2 evidence sheet (summary) for procurement.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx (MAP template), redwood_q1_performance_report.pdf, adeptly_usage_q1.csv

Immediate next steps (post-call):
- Ben: finalize pricing table and contract term language (3 business days).
- Marissa: finalize 2-slide ops + ROI deck (3 business days).
- Grace: send final MAP + contract draft to procurement and schedule legal review.

If anything changes before Tue morning, I’ll update the invite. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead, Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference

[attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx (DOCX), redwood_q1_performance_report.pdf (PDF), adeptly_usage_q1.csv (CSV)]
